**[Heatwaves increase sub-leaf-scale heterogeneity in leaf temperature]**
Xuemeng Mu, Mark K. J. Ooi, Rocco F. Notarnicola, Will K. Cornwell

This repository contains the data and R scripts used to analyse the effects of heatwave intensity, heatwave duration, and soil water availability on leaf temperature and plant physiological responses in *Xerochrysum bracteatum*.

## Repository structure

```text
.
├── Data/       # Datasets used in the analyses
├── Code/       # R scripts for analysis and figures
├── Figures/    # Figures generated for the manuscript
└── README.md
```

## Data

The `Data/` folder contains the cleaned datasets used for statistical analyses and figure production.

## Code

The scripts in the `Code/` folder reproduce the analyses and figures reported in the manuscript.

Please run them in numerical order:

1. `GLMM_statistics.R`
2. `LM_statistics.R`
3. `Plotting.R`

## Figures

The `Figures/` folder contains the figures generated from the analysis scripts and used in the manuscript.

## Required R packages

```r
install.packages(
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "glmmTMB",
    "emmeans",
    "DHARMa",
    "patchwork",
    "ggpubr",
    "gridExtra",
    "viridis",
    "rstatix",
    "gt",
    "car",
    "gamlss",
    "effectsize"
  )
)
```

## Reproducibility

To reproduce the analyses and figures, clone or download this repository, open it in RStudio or Positron, and run the scripts in the order listed above.
